name: cw-clear
description: Prototype: /cw-clear clears the conversation and submits a resume prompt, plus a turn heartbeat file. Off unless enabled.

enabled.title: Enable cw-clear
enabled.description: Master flag. When false the mod registers nothing and writes nothing.

resumeFile.title: Resume prompt file
resumeFile.description: Path of a file holding the resume prompt. Empty: run resumeCommand instead.

resumeCommand.title: Resume prompt command
resumeCommand.description: Whitespace-separated argv whose stdout is the resume prompt (used when resumeFile is empty).

stateFile.title: Heartbeat/state file
stateFile.description: JSON file rewritten on every turn event. Empty: heartbeat off.

probe.title: Spike probes
probe.description: Also register /cw-probe-* commands, a 2s clock.every log and a Bash tool.check logger. Spike only.
